products.name: Apple Watch SE 2nd gen
products.description:
Apple Watch SE 2nd gen

The Apple Watch SE 2nd gen is an advanced, feature-packed Apple Smart Watch designed for everyday use, fitness, and wellness tracking. Available in two sizes, 44mm and 40mm, the Apple Watch SE boasts a high-resolution Retina LTPO OLED display with up to 1000 nits of brightness, ensuring clear visibility even in bright sunlight. The 44mm model features a display resolution of 368 by 448 pixels, while the 40mm model has a resolution of 324 by 394 pixels, both offering sharp visuals at 326 pixels per inch. The Apple Watch SE 2nd gen Smart Watch is powered by the S8 SiP with a 64-bit dual-core processor and a 2-core Neural Engine, delivering a smooth performance with 32GB of storage. The Apple Watch SE 2nd gen is equipped with essential health and wellness sensors, including a second-generation optical heart sensor, a high-g accelerometer, and a high-dynamic-range gyroscope. It also includes an always-on altimeter, a compass, and an ambient light sensor for precise activity tracking and navigation. With advanced fitness capabilities, the Apple Watch SE Smartwatch supports various workouts, including running, cycling, swimming, hiking, and more, with metrics like heart rate zones, pace, and elevation. It features built-in safety tools, such as Fall Detection, Crash Detection, and Emergency SOS, alongside international emergency calling. The Apple Watch SE 2nd gen Smart Watch is water-resistant to 50 meters, making it ideal for swimming, and provides all-day battery life of up to 18 hours. The watch's operating system, watchOS, is user-friendly, with accessibility features like VoiceOver, Zoom, and AssistiveTouch, making it suitable for users with various disabilities. Connectivity is robust with GPS, Bluetooth 5.3, and Wi-Fi 4 support, and it integrates seamlessly with Apple services like Apple Pay, GymKit, and Apple Watch for Kids. The Apple Watch SE 2nd gen is available in both GPS and GPS + Cellular models, offering the flexibility to stay connected even when away from your phone.
